messages:
anya: Heads-up — saw a flurry of streaming reconnect loops from mobile clients this morning. root cause looks like a ~300–600ms delay in keepalive frames from our edge during GC bursts, clients give up and reconnect, which then causes duplicate billing spikes.
ben: Can you paste the sample logs? is this SSE or WS?
anya: SSE from EU edge. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-23T08:12:33Z] conn=abc123 keepalive_sent=false last_sent=2026-03-23T08:12:32Z delay=450ms
[2026-03-23T08:12:33Z] client=mobile-98 reconnecting reason=keepalive_timeout resume_token=rt:xyz
```
micah: ugh. That resume_token replay is what causes double-charge, right? client reconnect -> server treats as new request while resume window hasn't been honored.
anya: Exactly. We have a short server-side resume-window (50ms) + client gives up at 300ms. Edge delayed keepalive makes it worse.
ben: First cut options: 1) increase server resume-window to ~1s; 2) recommend clients use a larger grace window; 3) server emits an explicit "probe" immediately after GC to avoid client timeouts.
micah: Telemetry wise we need a per-route "reconnect-flap" counter and a heatmap of inter-reconnect intervals. Right now console shows only total reconnects which masks these bursts.
console-team: +1. We can add a small panel: reconnect_rate / minute, median inter-reconnect, and top 10 client agents. Should we also add an annotation for rollout flags?
anya: Yes — if we expose a per-route grace_window_ms (editable in Console) we can canary increasing it from 50->500ms for a subset of traffic. Need a UI guardrail so teams don't blindly set big windows and hide real issues.
ben: There's also billing dedupe: our metering treats resumed requests as new until the resume handshake completes. We could add a short dedupe window for billing accounts where token==resume_token and start_ts delta < 2s. That would stop immediate duplicate charges.
micah: I worry about edge cases if resume fails — we'd need a fallback to bill if the resumed request ends up doing significant work. Might be okay with a conservative threshold (e.g., tokens_generated>100).
anya: Proposed action items:
- infra: emit immediate keepalive/probe on edge after GC/pause (ben)
- runtime: bump resume-window default to 500ms behind a feature flag (micah)
- console: add per-route grace_window_ms setting + a reconnect-flap dashboard panel (console-team)
- billing: implement soft dedupe heuristic (billing-team, cc @sre-bot)

ben: quick repro test idea: run a local SSE client with timeout=250ms and instrument server to sleep 400ms between pings. If client reconnects and server still accepts resume, we should see resumed=true in logs and billing event dedupe.
micah: I'll write a unit/integration test for the resume handshake timing and make it run in CI with a simulated GC pause.
sre-bot: Deployment checklist: ensure feature flag gating for resume-window change, add canary rollout (1% -> 10% -> 100%), add alert on reconnect_rate spike >3x baseline.
console-team: UX question — default value suggestions? 500ms seems reasonable but make it configurable per route and show the current default in the UI with a tooltip about tradeoffs.
anya: Agreed. Also add a short note in the docs about client-side recommended grace (client_timeout >= resume_window * 2) and an example mobile config.
ben: I'll spike the probe patch today and push a draft PR. micah, can you own the feature flag? console-team, please mock the dashboard panels so we can iterate.
micah: owning feature flag + CI test.
console-team: will post a mock tomorrow, will add annotation support for canary flags.
anya: Thanks all. Follow-up thread for PRs + dashboard mocks. :thumbsup:
